series.name: Ideogram 4.0
series.note: Default and Quality are rendering-speed settings of native Ideogram 4.0. The unlabeled AA row is interpreted as Default under its default-settings policy; exact evaluated requests are unpublished. Turbo has a provider quote but no measured counterpart here.

series.name: Ideogram 4.0 Fast
series.note: Balanced (default) and Quality are rendering presets within the separate Ideogram 4.0 Fast model. The unlabeled row follows the documented default-settings policy. Representative 1K API prices do not establish the cost of the highest-resolution benchmark requests.
